plainTranslation: Emotional power struggles playing out through the relationship. Closeness becomes a contest - who needs more, who withholds, who controls the mood. Failure mode: each using vulnerability as leverage. Name the control out loud, share the emotional power, or step back.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their intensity and pull toward depth and control press against your feelings, needs, and sense of safety. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
tension: But this aspect can also become an emotional power struggle. One person may reach while the other withdraws. One person may need reassurance while the other resists being needed. Jealousy, possessiveness, emotional testing, and manipulation can emerge when fear takes over. The bond can become difficult to step away from, not because it is always nourishing, but because it touches the attachment system so deeply.
advice: The work is mutual care. Both people need to be honest about what they feel without using those feelings as weapons. This connection can deepen intimacy when vulnerability is respected. Without that respect, closeness can become destabilizing.
